title: Executivo Comercial Hunter Para Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de grandes contas, através das atuações porta a porta, Leads direcionados e também por construções de conexões e relacionamentos;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio;
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia;
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente;
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão;



Requisitos:

  • Possuir graduação completa;
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento;
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas
  • Ter experiência em negociar e fechar contratos;
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial (100% Externo).
  • Possuir carro próprio.



Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

Responsibilities

  • Manage all legal matters (mostly domestic but some international exposure as well).

    (iv) Ensuring legal is a force multiplier, not a bottleneck
  • Process Professionalization: Transition the legal department from "startup mode" to a disciplined "financial institution standard".
  • Risk Optimization: Translate legal constraints into business options. Quantify downside, propose alternatives, and recommend paths that maximize long-term enterprise value
  • Regulatory: Manage the process of applying for SCD (Sociedade de Crédito Direto) License, exposure to Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Open Finance, Consumer protection at scale (BACEN + SENACON dynamics), Structuring new financial products under regulatory ambiguity
  • Be ready to contribute to potential capital raise/M&A processes, manage data rooms, oversee due diligence, and negotiate complex term sheets.


Qualifications

  • 15–20 years of experience.
  • Ideal candidate will bring a generalist expertise being able to navigate Brazilian Employment law, Tax basics, Contract law (Brazil & International), Regulatory, M&A.
  • Ideal candidate has a combination of top-tier law firm and in-house
  • Start-up experience (ideally at a Fintech)
  • Proven People Leadership
  • Language: English fluency is a must.
  • Location: São Paulo. (Hybrid work environment)


This role is NOT for:

  • Pure advisory profiles who prefer external counsel to execution
  • Lawyers who have not personally built, hired, and performance-managed teams
  • Professionals uncomfortable making fast risk trade-offs with imperfect information
  • Candidates who need heavy structure before acting

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Java Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 54563


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


O que você deve ter?


- Domínio em Java (8+) e ecossistema Spring (Boot, Data, Security, Cloud, Batch, MVC);

- Conhecimento emDesign Patterns e princípios SOLID;

- Experiência comarquitetura em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP), incluindo uso de serviços como ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3 ou CloudWatch;

- Vivência com mensageria e filas (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, SNS) para integração entre sistemas e processamento assíncrono;

- Experiência combancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis);

- Prática em CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) e versionamento com Git;

- Experiência comconteinerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm);

- Conhecimento emtestes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, integração e performance);

- Desejável: conhecimento em NodeJS para integrações leves, APIs RESTful e documentação com Swagger/OpenAPI;

- Experiência comobservabilidade e monitoramento (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk) será um diferencial;


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Seguro de Vida;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Home Office;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter Para Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Curitiba, Pr
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de grandes contas, através das atuações porta a porta, Leads direcionados e também por construções de conexões e relacionamentos;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio;
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia;
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente;
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão;



Requisitos:


  • Ter disponibilidade para atuar em Curitiba, PR.
  • Possuir graduação completa;
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento;
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas
  • Ter experiência em negociar e fechar contratos;
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial (100% Externo).
  • Possuir carro próprio.



Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Corretor De Imóveis Corporativo
description:
Estamos em busca de Consultores Imobiliários Corporativos, com ou sem experiência no mercado.


Resumo do Cargo

Você fará parte de uma equipe selecionada de corretores que atuam nos principais bairros da capital (Vila Olímpia, Itaim Bibi, Faria Lima, Brooklin, Pinheiros, Paulista), com a maior taxa de comissionamento do mercado (até 45%), ajuda de custo e treinamento. Sua atuação será identificar oportunidades de negócios, assessorar clientes na compra, venda e locação de imóveis corporativos (conjuntos, lajes e monousuários) e garantir a satisfação do cliente ao longo de todo o processo.


Como Ter Sucesso no Cargo

Para ter sucesso, o candidato deve ter comprometimento, habilidade de comunicação e negociação, bom atendimento ao cliente, ser dinâmico, organizado e proativo.


Como Este Cargo Se Encaixa na Organização

Como Consultor Imobiliário, você atuará como um ponto de contato chave entre a empresa e os clientes, contribuindo para o crescimento da carteira de imóveis e a consolidação da reputação da empresa no mercado. Sua atuação será vital para o sucesso das operações imobiliárias da organização.


Responsabilidades


  • Identificar e prospectar oportunidades de negócios no setor imobiliário corporativo.


  • Conduzir visitas a imóveis e apresentar propostas aos clientes.


  • Negociar condições de compra, venda e locação de imóveis, garantindo a satisfação de todas as partes envolvidas.


  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências do mercado imobiliário e a legislação vigente.


  • Elaborar relatórios e manter registros de negociações e atividades de clientes.


Qualificações


  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e em equipe.


  • Comunicação verbal e escrita eficientes.


  • Habilidades de negociação.


  • Organização.


  • Competência para realizar análises de mercado.


  • Proatividade.


  • Entender as necessidades dos clientes e oferecer soluções adequadas.


  • Ser persuasivo.


  • Postura profissional e apresentação pessoal adequada


Local de Trabalho:

Presencial - São Paulo, Vila Olímpia


Se você se considera com disposição para evoluir todos os dias e alcançar patamares de excelência, nós queremos você em nosso time!

title: National Sales Director (Brazil)
description:
Job Title: National Sales Director - Brazil

Reports To: Head of Overseas Business Unit

Location: Brazil (Remote, frequent travel required)


Position Overview

To support the company's strategic development, we are investing significantly in the Brazilian market to accelerate brand growth, product localization, and sales network expansion. We are seeking a National Sales Director for Brazil who will be responsible for the overall market strategy, sales planning, channel development, and team leadership. The goal is to rapidly achieve broad product coverage across Brazil and develop tailored product and sales strategies for the local market.

The ideal candidate will have established nationwide distributor and customer relationships, enabling them to contribute immediately. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience at leading baking ingredient manufacturers in a similar role.


Key Responsibilities

A. Market Strategy & Planning

  1. Develop and execute the overall sales strategy, channel plan, and annual business objectives for Brazil.
  2. Lead product localization initiatives to meet Brazilian market needs and drive product adaptation.
  3. Rapidly expand the national sales network to ensure broad market coverage.

B. Channel Development & Management

  1. Identify, negotiate with, and onboard national distributors and key strategic partners.
  2. Manage relationships with distributors and major customers, optimizing processes and service delivery.
  3. Maintain distributor and customer profiles, conduct regular performance reviews, and implement improvement plans.

C. Brand & Marketing Promotion

  1. Develop and implement brand-building activities, including marketing campaigns, PR events, and digital outreach.
  2. Organize product demonstrations, technical trainings, and industry exhibitions to increase brand visibility.

D. Cross-functional Collaboration

  1. Work closely with product, R&D, and marketing teams to share market insights and support product development.
  2. Provide training and support to distributors and customers on products, applications, and sales techniques.

E. Market & Competitive Intelligence

  1. Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and regulatory changes to adjust strategies proactively.
  2. Prepare regular market reports and business forecasts for headquarters.


Qualifications

A. Experience

  1. Minimum 15 years of sales management experience in the baking ingredients industry, with a focus on non-dairy whipping toppings or related products, specifically in the Brazilian market.
  2. Previous experience in a similar role at companies is highly preferred.
  3. Established network of national distributors and key clients, with the ability to execute quickly.

B. Knowledge

  1. Full understanding of bakery products and familiarity with bakery operations or production processes.
  2. Proficient in Microsoft Office for data analysis, reporting, and presentation.

C. Competency

  1. Strong strategic thinking, negotiation skills, and business acumen.
  2. Resilient under pressure and willing to travel frequently.
  3. Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.


We Offer

  1. Competitive compensation package.
  2. Opportunity to lead in a high-priority strategic market with significant growth potential.
  3. Full support from global headquarters in product, marketing, and technical resources.

Shanghai Hi-road Food Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading integrated enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of premium bakery and catering ingredients. Committed to becoming the preferred partner in the global baking industry, we dedicate ourselves to providing customers with innovative, safe, and delicious food solutions.

With our strong independent R&D capabilities, Hi-Road meticulously sources world-class raw materials and employs advanced production technologies. Our comprehensive quality control system ensures the consistent excellence of our diverse product portfolio, which includes:

title: Senior Portfolio Manager
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America.

We originate more than R$700M per year in B2B credit to Brazilian SMEs through CrediPay, our embedded finance platform. We operate in a segment where traditional financial infrastructure is limited, building proprietary credit intelligence and risk frameworks that do not yet exist in this market.

By combining structured capital markets solutions with real-time credit decisioning, we enable marketplaces and suppliers to offer seamless payment terms to their buyers, while we manage risk, pricing, and capital efficiency behind the scenes.

We are not a traditional lender. We are building the risk engine that powers scalable B2B commerce in Brazil.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

We are looking for a Senior Portfolio Manager to take end-to-end ownership of portfolio performance and Cost of Risk outcomes. This position reports directly to the Head of Risk.

You will steer portfolio mix and concentration risk, continuously improve provisioning and loss forecasting accuracy, and design risk-adjusted pricing frameworks that enable disciplined but ambitious GTM growth. This is a senior individual contributor role with direct commercial impact and close collaboration across GTM, Treasury, and Collections.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in credit risk, portfolio management, or structured lending
  • Advanced SQL required;
    Python strongly preferred
  • Proven ownership of Cost of Risk (CoR) and portfolio performance
  • Strong understanding of credit cycles, concentration risk, and sector deterioration
  • Hands-on experience with provisioning models (e.G., IFRS9) and expected loss methodologies
  • Experience building risk-adjusted pricing frameworks
  • Strong commercial judgment — able to enable growth while protecting downside risk
  • Experience working closely with collections or recovery teams
  • Clear communicator, able to translate portfolio insights into business steering decisions
  • Experience with structured vehicles (e.G., FIDC) preferred


Responsibilities

  • Own portfolio steering across channels, sectors, ratings, and accounts
  • Monitor large exposures and concentration risk
  • Steer origination mix to balance growth and profitability
  • Deliver Cost of Risk in line or better than budget
  • Own and improve provisioning logic and expected loss methodologies
  • Reduce variance between expected and realised losses
  • Work closely with Collections to incorporate recovery insights into forecasting assumptions
  • Own risk-adjusted pricing logic for new and existing proposals
  • Partner with GTM to structure commercially competitive yet disciplined offers
  • Build scalable pricing and steering tooling to support faster decision-making
  • Align portfolio strategy with treasury constraints and capital efficiency


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Software Developer
description:
Job Description

The Company:

Hexagon is a global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. We are putting data to work to boost efficiency, productivity, quality, and safety across industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, public sector, and mobility applications.

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous — ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

Hexagon’s Mining division solves surface and underground mine challenges with proven technologies for planning, operations, and safety.

Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) has approximately 21,000 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 4.6bn USD. Learn more at hexagon.Com and follow us @HexagonAB.


Purpose of Position:

Hexagon Mining develops fleet management solutions for manned and unmanned operation for open pit mining. The solutions integrate in-vehicle, on prem and cloud components to improve the mining operation productivity and safety. The software developer will join a team that contributes to Hexagon’s fleet management solutions, primarily in the development of test and deployment infrastructure


Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop and support functionality and components of the fleet management solution offering.
  • Collaborate closely with the backend, frontend, firmware, and DevOps development teams to realize new integrated solutions.
  • Develop Deployment and Testing Infra of the solutions
  • Bring innovative ideas for further development.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent
  • Professional experience in software development.
  • Experience with .NET/C#, backend development, RESTful API, web frontends (React/JS/HTML/CSS).
  • Experience with Linux and Docker.
  • Experience with Git and agile development processes (e.G. Scrum, SAFe).
  • Full professional English proficiency.
  • Team oriented and able to work independently.
  • Positive working attitude and good general common sense to understand business requirements in mining.
  • Willing to travel to company’s offices and customer visits overseas occasionally.


Desirable:

  • Experience with Python.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with continuous integration and test automation.
  • Background on game development


Benefits:

  • Health plan
  • Comprehensive health program (psychological, nutritional, legal, financial, and social assistance)
  • Wellhub (Gym)
  • Life insurance
  • Meal/food allowance
  • Dental plan
  • Private pension plan


Travel Requirements:

5-10% of the time


You will work on products that could revolutionize the mining industry in the next 5 years. Your colleagues consist of highly qualified and open-minded engineers from all over the world. Beside the developer career you will have the opportunity to develop into multiple directions like project management, product management, customer support and sales.

Join our team as a software developer and make a significant impact on our clients' digital transformation initiatives. We offer a stimulating work environment, competitive compensation package, and opportunities for professional growth. Apply now and help shape the future of Hexagon’s technology solutions.

title: Analista Financeiro Sênior
description:
Estamos com oportunidade na área de Tesouraria Corporativa!

Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado e com interesse em atuar de forma estratégica na gestão financeira da companhia. Essa posição terá papel fundamental no controle de liquidez, fluxo de caixa e relacionamento com instituições financeiras.


Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar a gestão do caixa consolidado, acompanhando diariamente as posições das empresas do grupo e contribuindo para a otimização da liquidez;
  • Suportar o processo de projeção de fluxo de caixa direto (curto, médio e longo prazo), analisando variações e identificando oportunidades de melhoria na gestão do capital de giro;
  • Executar e acompanhar operações de aplicações financeiras, incluindo análise de rentabilidade e negociação de condições com instituições financeiras, garantindo aderência às políticas internas;
  • Apoiar o fechamento mensal dos resultados financeiros relacionados às aplicações e instrumentos de tesouraria;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações executivas, com indicadores de tesouraria, posição de caixa consolidado e rentabilidade dos investimentos;
  • Atuar no relacionamento com instituições financeiras, acompanhando operações, negociando condições e identificando oportunidades de investimento;
  • Interagir com áreas internas como Contabilidade, Planejamento Financeiro e Controladoria, apoiando rotinas de fechamento e alinhamento de informações;
  • Contribuir com melhorias de processos, automação e desenvolvimento de ferramentas de análise na área de Tesouraria Corporativa.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em Tesouraria, Fluxo de Caixa ou áreas financeiras;
  • Conhecimento emgestão de fluxo de caixa e aplicações financeiras;
  • Excel intermediário ou avançado;
  • Experiência comERP (preferencialmente SAP) e/ou sistemas de tesouraria será um diferencial.


Requisitos Comportamentais:

  • Perfil analítico e atenção a detalhes;
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de rotinas financeiras;
  • Proatividade naidentificação de oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Boa comunicaçãoe facilidade de interação com diferentes áreas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com prazos e demandas simultâneas.

description:

A Legrand hoje:

  • Novo lema “Vivaa Vida”, focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

title: Formação De Assessores De Investimentos
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Assessor(a) de Investimentos para atuar de forma estratégica na construção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, oferecendo soluções financeiras personalizadas e alinhadas aos objetivos de curto, médio e longo prazo.

Esta posição contempla uma jornada estruturada de formação , na qual o profissional desenvolve competências técnicas e comerciais até assumir a gestão de carteira e evoluir na carreira de assessoria dentro da EQI.


Jornada de Formação – Assessor(a) de Investimentos EQI

A jornada é estruturada para acelerar o desenvolvimento técnico, comercial e estratégico do profissional, que desde o primeiro dia já atua como Assessor(a) de Investimentos EQI.


  • 1º mês | Onboarding
  • Período de imersão completa na estrutura da EQI, com foco em capacitação técnica e comercial. O assessor aprofunda conhecimentos sobre mercado financeiro, produtos, processos internos, ferramentas e cultura organizacional, além de desenvolver habilidades de vendas e abordagem consultiva.


  • 2º mês | Prospecção
  • Início da atuação comercial supervisionada, com foco na geração de oportunidades. O profissional realiza prospecção ativa, qualificação de leads, participa de reuniões e estrutura seu pipeline, evoluindo na condução de conversas estratégicas com investidores.


  • 3º e 4º meses | Aquisição
  • Fase de maior autonomia na condução do ciclo comercial. O assessor passa a realizar reuniões, captar recursos e estruturar as primeiras carteiras, desenvolvendo capacidade de negociação, relacionamento e fechamento de negócios.


  • Meses seguintes | Alocação e Consolidação
  • Momento de fortalecimento e expansão da carteira, com definição de estratégias de investimento, adequação de produtos ao perfil do cliente e aprofundamento do relacionamento de longo prazo.
  • Ao longo de toda a jornada, o profissional conta com simulações comerciais com apoio de IA , suporte técnico especializado e fornecimento de leads para impulsionar o crescimento.


  • Evolução
  • Após a conclusão da formação, permanece como Assessor(a) de Investimentos EQI, agora com maior domínio técnico, autonomia ampliada e atuação mais estratégica com plano de carreira estruturado com 12 Níveis de desenvolvimento.


O que importa no nosso processo seletivo?

- Fit Cultural;

- Certificação CPA-20 (CPA +CPROR), CEA (CPROI) ou CFP;

- Conhecimento sobre Investimentos (RV, RF, Fundos, entre outros);

- Perfil comercial e relacional;

- Disponibilidadeem tempo integral (100% presencial);

- Experiência mínima de 6 meses de atuação profissional no Mercado Financeiro (Banco, Corretora, AAI ou Family Office).


Por que escolher a EQI?

  • Plano de carreira estruturado e diferenciado;
  • Suporte e acompanhamento integral das lideranças no dia a dia;
  • Feedbacks estruturados;
  • Sistemas avançados e tecnologias de ponta;
  • Plataformas próprias de desenvolvimento profissional (EaD) com mais de 350 treinamentos disponíveis (habilidades técnicas e comportamentais);
  • Possibilidade real de Partnership.


Informações adicionais

Benefícios:

Salário + PPR Anual

VA/VR de R$ 1.812

title: Assembly And After-Sales Support Technician
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician

Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required

Reports to: Account Manager and CTO

Contract Type: CLT


About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.


Position Summary:

The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.

Position duties and responsibilities:

  • Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
  • Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
  • Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
  • Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
  • Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
  • Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
  • Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.


Qualification and requirements:

  • Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
  • Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
  • Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.


Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.


LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.


Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:

  • Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician .
  • Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English .
  • Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.
  • Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

title: Motion Graphics Video Editor
description:
Company Description

Holy Koolaid is a YouTube channel dedicated to science, skepticism, and critical thinking . The channel explores topics such as archaeology, religion, pseudoscience, cults, history, and misinformation. Our goal is to create engaging educational content that encourages curiosity and critical thinking .


Role Description

Holy Koolaid Media is looking for a highly skilled video editor with strong motion graphics experience to help produce fast-paced documentary and explainer videos for YouTube. Our content explores history, archaeology, science, and critical thinking , often examining religion, pseudoscience, and misinformation through a skeptical lens. We are looking for someone who can turn research-heavy scripts into compelling visual stories using animation, motion graphics, archival footage, and creative editing. This role requires someone who is detail-oriented, intellectually curious, and comfortable working with complex historical and scientific material . The position is fully remote , with occasional meetings in São Paulo preferred but not required .


What You'll Do

  • Edit long-form YouTube documentary and explainer videos
  • Create motion graphics and animations that help explain complex ideas
  • Cut footage to match script timing and narration
  • Add B-roll, archival footage, and visual references
  • Design and animate titles, diagrams, maps, and visual explanations
  • Add sound effects and polish audio
  • Work closely with the creator to ensure the visuals enhance the storytelling
  • Help research and locate visual assets relevant to historical and scientific topics
  • Maintain strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy and clarity


Required Skills

  • Strong experience with Adobe Premiere Pro (this is essential)
  • Experience with Photoshop
  • Experience creating motion graphics or animation
  • Ability to edit according to script timing and narrative pacing
  • Strong visual storytelling instincts
  • Extremely detail-oriented
  • Ability to research and find visual material when needed
  • At least 2 years of experience with motion graphics or animation
  • Ability to work independently and solve problems


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with After Effects
  • Some familiarity with Adobe Audition
  • Experience editing YouTube videos
  • Experience with documentary-style editing
  • Interest in history, archaeology, or science
  • Comfortable working on content that critically examines religion, pseudoscience, and misinformation
  • English proficiency at B1 level or higher (flexible if editing skills are exceptional)


What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate:

  • Thinks like a storyteller, not just an editor
  • Can take complex ideas and make them visually understandable
  • Is comfortable learning new topics quickly
  • Is curious and enjoys researching historical and scientific subjects
  • Can work with fast-paced YouTube content
  • Has the resilience and independence to figure things out and solve problems


How to Apply

Please include:

  • Portfolio or demo reel
  • Examples of motion graphics or animation work
  • Examples of video editing projects
  • A short note explaining why you are interested in this role

Applicants without a portfolio or demo reel will not be considered.

title: Technical Account Manager, Hybrid São Paulo
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is a leading B2B ecosystem player in the TravelTech space, connecting and empowering businesses in the ever-evolving world of travel. We drive growth for our clients and partners while removing friction from the end-to-end travel experience. Our cloud-based technology platforms offer fast and reliable access to a unique portfolio of travel products & services, while rich data and intelligence seamlessly connect supply and demand worldwide.


We have over more than 3,000 experts worldwide, including specialists on the ground who provide insights and support to boost trading even further, especially in the most hard-to-reach segments. This unique blend of technology, data and passionate people serves as a catalyst for all businesses aiming to unlock their full potential in the travel arena.


HBX Group comprises four best-in-class B2B brands that meet the needs of its growing and diverse client base across 190+ global markets:


- Hotelbeds, who cater for the specific needs of hoteliers, tour operators, airlines and online travel agents


- Bedsonline, exclusively serving the retail travel segment


- Roiback, the HotelTech partner for independent hotels and chains seeking growth through direct channel solutions


- TravelStack, providing all products, services and solutions to businesses looking to enter into the lucrative travel arena.


Job Summary


We are looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) with a strong technology foundation and a proven ability to deliver strategic solutions for enterprise clients. This role combines technical expertise with customer-centric account management , ensuring seamless integration, optimization, and long-term success for our most strategic partners.

As a TAM, you will act as a trusted advisor , building strong relationships with key accounts, driving technical excellence, and collaborating across global teams. You will lead technical engagements, oversee API client optimization, and provide proactive solutions that align with business objectives. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and is passionate about solving complex technical challenges.


Job Responsibilities


Territory Growth & Development

  • Partner with sales teams to position and deliver technical solutions to strategic customers through presentations, demos, evaluations, and technical objection handling.
  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for key accounts, ensuring smooth communication and integration.
  • Maximize product adoption and distribution from a technical perspective .

Solution Delivery & Optimization

  • Lead all technical activities related to customer onboarding and API integrations.
  • Provide post-sales technical support , troubleshoot issues, and resolve complex cases.
  • Analyze client performance and define optimization strategies to drive efficiency and scalability.
  • Develop scripts and automation tools to monitor, alert, and report on production environments.

Collaboration & Governance

  • Work closely with internal teams and external partners to align technical requirements with business goals.
  • Participate in global and regional projects , ensuring timely delivery and accurate reporting.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation and ensure KPIs are consistently met.

Required Skills & Experience


  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering , or related field.
  • Proven experience as a Strategic Technical Account Manager or similar role.
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, XML, JSON , and related technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with Databases & SQL .
  • Understanding of automation practices across development, build, and deployment phases.
  • Familiarity with build management and CI/CD tools .
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to produce clear, maintainable documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills , initiative, and ability to work in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience in the Travel Industry is a plus.
  • ADVANCED ENGLISH is a must

At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.


You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

title: Business Analyst Fx Markets
description:
A global financial institution is looking for a Business Analyst with experience in FX Markets to support the evolution of trading and market infrastructure platforms.

The role involves working closely with trading desks, product specialists, and technology teams to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions across the FX ecosystem.

Role Overview


You will act as a key interface between business stakeholders and technology teams , helping shape solutions that support trading, pricing, and electronic market access. The position requires a solid understanding of FX products as well as the ability to structure requirements and support the delivery lifecycle of technology initiatives.


Main Responsibilities

  • Work with trading and business teams to understand workflows and translate them into structured functional requirements
  • Support the design of system integrations and APIs , ensuring proper data flows between platforms
  • Analyze trading processes and identify opportunities to optimize or streamline existing solutions
  • Participate in the delivery lifecycle , including requirement clarification, testing support, and user validation
  • Collaborate with global teams across technology, architecture, and product to ensure alignment on project objectives
  • Maintain clear and well-structured documentation of functional specifications and process flows


Profile

  • Previous experience as a Business Analyst within FX or Global Markets environments
  • Good understanding of FX products such as spot, forwards, swaps, NDFs, or electronic trading flows
  • Experience working with API-driven systems or integration projects
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to structure complex topics clearly
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving and collaborative environment


Additional Skills

  • Exposure to electronic trading platforms or market connectivity environments
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery frameworks in financial services
  • Experience using tools such as Jira or Confluence
  • Basic knowledge of SQL or Python for data analysis or validation

title: Global Hrbp
description:
About JD's International Business

We are committed to building a digitally intelligent cross-border supply chain and global retail infrastructure. Leveraging our global supply chain capabilities, JD continues to expand in markets where we possess distinct competitive advantages. Our diversified businesses—including retail, logistics, technology, industrial development, manufacturing, and healthcare—are growing in synergy. Currently, JD operates worldwide, with a presence in countries and regions such as China, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, France, Germany, Spain, Brazil, Hungary, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE, serving customers across the globe.


Position Mission

As a core HR partner for our international expansion, you will be at the forefront of our rapidly growing global business. This is not just an HR role—it is a mission to become a "Growth Engine" and "Organizational Architect" for the business. We invest in your future through a unique 6-to-12-month immersive rotation program at our Beijing Headquarters. This program is designed to provide an in-depth understanding of our core business, culture, and operations, empowering you to drive organizational capability, build world-class teams, and ensure our people strategy accelerates our global growth.


Core Responsibilities

1. Global Talent Program: Beijing Headquarters Rotation (6–12 Months)

- Immerse yourself in the core operations, culture, and leadership network of our global business.

- Participate in structured training and mentorship while contributing to key projects in talent acquisition, organizational development, and HR analytics.

- Build a solid foundation and holistic perspective before transitioning to support international business teams.


2. Strategic HR Partnership & Business Insight

- Translate business strategies in international markets (e.G., Southeast Asia, Europe, North America, Middle East) into actionable people strategies.

- Provide forward-looking insights on organizational design, talent density, and cultural integration.


3. Talent Engine & Pipeline Development

- Lead end-to-end recruitment for critical roles in supply chain, warehouse management, cross-border logistics, and localized operations.

- Design and implement talent development initiatives such as the "Global Young Talent Program" to build a robust pipeline of future leaders.


4. Organizational Effectiveness & Team Activation

- Diagnose and optimize organizational structures and processes to enhance collaboration and performance in cross-cultural settings.

- Drive a results-oriented performance management system and leverage HR data to support business decision-making.


5. Global Culture & Employee Experience

- Champion JD’s corporate culture and foster an open, agile, and inclusive team environment across regions.

- Proactively manage employee relations and enhance the end-to-end employee lifecycle experience.


Qualifications & Attributes

We are seeking a future leader with business acumen, an entrepreneurial mindset, and high growth potential—not just a traditional HR practitioner.


Must-Haves

- Bachelor’s degree or above with at least 5 years of HR experience. Experience in internet, e-commerce, retail, logistics, or consulting is preferred.

- Global mindset: Overseas study/work experience or prior exposure to supporting international business is highly advantageous.

- Business acumen: Strong interest and ability to quickly grasp business logic, profitability models, and core challenges.

- Superior cognitive and problem-solving skills:

- Structured thinking: Ability to dissect complex situations and develop clear solution frameworks.

- Data-driven: Skilled in using data analysis to identify issues, validate hypotheses, and drive decisions.

- Drive & resilience:

- Ownership: Takes full responsibility for business challenges and outcomes.

- Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and views challenges as growth opportunities.


Core Competencies

- Excellent communication and influencing skills across all levels and cultures.

- A keen eye for identifying and developing high-potential talent.

- Collaborative team player.


What We Offer

- A 6-to-12-month foundational rotation at Beijing Headquarters, connecting you with the core of our business and setting the stage for long-term success.

- A platform at the forefront of international growth, where your contributions directly impact our core strategy.

- Accelerated career growth by solving complex, real-world business challenges from day one.

- An environment of trust and autonomy that encourages bold thinking and innovation.

title: Field Cto
description:
WSO2 is looking for a visionary Field CTO to join our Latin American Sales Engineering team. As a company at the forefront of API Management, Integration, and Identity & Access Management (IAM), WSO2 provides the foundational "digital freedom" for enterprises to innovate without vendor lock-in.

The Field CTO is a high-impact, senior-level technology sales professional who acts as the "voice of the technology" in the field. You will serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives at our most strategic accounts, providing thought leadership and architectural guidance that aligns WSO2’s open-source and SaaS solutions with our customers' long-term business goals. This is a hybrid role that demands the technical depth of an architect and the influential communication of a senior sales executive.


Key Responsibilities

  • Evangelism & Thought Leadership: Represent WSO2 at major industry conferences, executive roundtables, and in the media. Author white papers, blogs, and reference architectures that define the future of digital transformation and decentralized integration.
  • Strategic Sales Support: Partner with the Latin American sales team to lead "top-down" technical engagements. You will own the technical relationship with CXOs, helping them understand how WSO2 fits into their broader enterprise ecosystem.
  • Architectural Advisory: Provide high-level architectural oversight for strategic pre-sales opportunities and critical post-sales implementations. Ensure that customer deployments are scalable, secure, and follow industry best practices.
  • Market Intelligence & Feedback Loop: Act as a bridge between the Latam market and WSO2 Product Management. Translate customer challenges and market trends into actionable product requirements to influence the roadmap of our internal developer platforms and SaaS offerings.
  • Post-Sales Strategic Alignment: For key accounts, continue to provide periodic executive-level reviews to ensure the realized value of the WSO2 platform and identify expansion opportunities based on the customer’s evolving digital roadmap.
  • Mentorship: Act as a mentor to the broader Sales Engineering team, elevating their ability to communicate business value alongside technical features.

Qualifications, Skills, and Relevant Experience

  • 12+ years of experience in technical sales, enterprise architecture, or professional services, with at least 3 years in a leadership or "Field CTO" equivalent role.
  • Proven track record of selling to and advising Fortune 500 companies within the Latin American or North American market.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep technical knowledge in at least two of the following technical domains: API Management, Enterprise Integration, Microservices, Identity & Access Management (CIAM/IAM), Internal Developer Platforms, and AI
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent business experience is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional ability to distill complex technical concepts into business outcomes for CEOs, CTOs, and CISOs.
  • Strong understanding of the open-source ecosystem, cloud-native architectures (Kubernetes, Docker), and SaaS delivery models.
  • Ability to pivot between a deep-dive technical discussion with architects and a value-based business discussion with a CIO or CFO.
  • Ability to see beyond a single transaction to build a multi-year partnership with a customer.
  • Exceptional public speaking, writing, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel across Latin America (approximately 30-40%) to engage with customers and attend industry events.
  • Fluent English & Spanish

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility
  • Ongoing training, coaching, and mentoring
  • Education reimbursement for professional qualifications and courses
  • A generous vacation/leave plan that fits your needs
  • Health insurance for you and your family

Diversity Drives Innovation

We’ve built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it’s important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual’s strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation;
it also ensures that wecan create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

title: Gerente De Tesouraria
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos a Copa Energia, uma empresa brasileira que nasceu da vontade e do esforço de empreendedores em inovar de forma sustentável, valorizando a vida e oferecendo produtos e serviços que aquecem, alimentam e movem o país inteiro. Vamos construir um amanhã melhor, energizando o Brasil inteiro a partir de uma matriz energética mais limpa.


Através das nossas duas marcas, Copagaz e Liquigás, respondemos por 25% da distribuição de Gás Liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP) do Brasil. Possuímos operações em 24 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina. Somos uma empresa privada, que está presente em milhares de lares desde os anos 50. Além disso, fazemos parte do seleto grupo de investidas ItauSA.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Tesouraria para fazer parte do nosso time em São Paulo, SP (Zona Sul).


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Supervisionar o fluxo de caixa da empresa, garantindo que haja fundos adequados para as operações diárias, bem como para atender a obrigações de pagamento e investimentos
  • Avaliar as necessidades de financiamento da empresa e desenvolver estratégias para garantir acesso a fontes de financiamento adequadas, como empréstimos bancários, emissão de títulos ou outras formas de financiamento.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de investimento para maximizar os retornos sobre o excesso de caixa da empresa, considerando os objetivos de liquidez e tolerância ao risco.
  • Identificar e mitigar os riscos financeiros associados às atividades de tesouraria, incluindo riscos de mercado, liquidez e crédito.
  • Manter relacionamentos sólidos com instituições financeiras, negociar termos favoráveis de produtos e serviços bancários e monitorar o desempenho dos serviços prestados pelos bancos.
  • Preparar relatórios financeiros regulares para a alta administração e órgãos reguladores, garantindo conformidade com as normas contábeis e regulamentações financeiras aplicáveis.
  • Identificar oportunidades para melhorar a eficiência dos processos de tesouraria por meio da automação e implementação de sistemas e tecnologias financeiras.
  • Gestão de Pessoas, estruturação de time.
  • Gestão dos pagamentos, bem como dos normativos para garantir os processos bem como a melhora no capital de giro no que tange à PMP
  • Encontrar melhores práticas de como fazer melhor e de forma mais eficiente os processos atuais.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Compras, Gestão Empresarial, Financeiro e afins;

Atuação como referência técnica e estratégica. Lidera iniciativas complexas, eleva maturidade de engenharia, orienta decisões sistêmicas e conecta arquitetura, produto e negócio para maximizar valor sustentável.



Aqui, seu papel será:

-Projetar e implementar soluções robustas, escaláveis e seguras, antecipando cenários de falha, custos técnicos (quantidade requisições, performace, etc) e evolução.

usar dados operacionaispara propor melhorias de estabilidade, performance e custo.

-Influenciar e revisar decisões arquiteturais, propondo simplificação, modularidade e redução de dívidas técnicas.

-Incorporar práticas de segurança desde o design;
revisar código com focoem vulnerabilidades e conformidade com diretrizes internas.

-Fatiar trabalho complexo em incrementos entregáveis;
orientar priorização considerando dependências, riscos e valor.

-Navegar ambiguidade definindo hipóteses, opções e critérios de decisão;
tomar decisões sob pressão com responsabilidade.

-Assumir ownership de entregas críticas e alinhar expectativas com stakeholders antes de riscos emergirem.

retroalimentar áreas deproduto e negócio.

-Comunicar com clareza a diferentes públicos;
transformar complexidade técnica em linguagem acessível.

-Disseminar conhecimento (docs duradouras, sessões técnicas, padrões);
criar cultura de compartilhamento.

-Remover impedimentos de equipe e articular colaboração entre times adjacentes.

-Construir relacionamentos de confiança interfuncionais (engenharia, produto, negócio, segurança).

-Mediar desacordos com postura neutra, dados e foco em objetivo;
promover ambiente seguro de discussão.

-Tomar decisões conscientes de vieses;
registrar racional e resultados para aprendizagem futura.

-Assegurar alinhamento contínuo com objetivos estratégicos e OKRs;
ajustar execução conforme direção organizacional.

-Propor e implantar melhorias de processo (code review, fluxo de release, gestão de incidentes, CI/CD).

-Facilitar reuniões técnicas garantindo inclusão e decisões claras acionáveis.

-Mentorar profissionais menos experientes para criar redundância de capacidades e acelerar maturidade.

-Relacionar escolhas técnicas ao impacto de negócio e experiência do usuário;
influenciar roadmap comsimplificações.

-Participar e/ou liderar iniciativas estratégicas de engenharia (padronização, arquitetura evolutiva, resiliência).

-Liderear as reuniões com plataforma de negócios

-Elaborar e executar testes positivos, negativos, regressivos, teste de mutação e testes de stress.


Requisitos Técnicos:

-Domínio profundo de design de software (modularidade, limites de contexto, padrões arquiteturais, refatoração sistemática).

-Experiência sólida em testes avançados (contratos, mutação, arquitetura, não funcionais) e construção de pipelines de qualidade.

-Forte atuação em observabilidade (design de métricas, SLO/SLA, análise de tendência, otimização de alertas).

-Excelência em depuração distribuída (logs correlacionados, tracing, análise de concorrência, degradação de performance).

-Git avançado (fluxos complexos, revisão estratégica, automação).

-Práticas maduras de segurança (secure coding, gestão de segredos, mitigação de vulnerabilidades, threat modeling básico).

-Experiência com CI/CD e automação;
melhoria de tempo de ciclo e confiabilidade de deploy.

-Capacidade de refatorar legado com plano de mitigação de risco e métricas de sucesso.

-Entendimento de Custo operacional (latência, throughput, memória, escalabilidade horizontal vs vertical).

-Familiaridade com integração de múltiplos paradigmas (REST, gRPC, assíncrono, eventos) e suas implicações.

-Uso de dados para dirigir decisões técnicas (logs, métricas, custo infra, erros e tendências).

-Conhecimento teorico de conceitos de Cloud e ferramentas AWS.


Competências Comportamentais:

-Autonomia alta com discernimento para escalonar apenas o necessário.

-Influência técnica positiva e construção de consenso.

-Pensamento sistêmico e visão de longo prazo.

  • Sector Knowledge : Understanding of FMCG/retail and consumer goods policy environment (sustainability, product data, packaging, product safety, traceability, e-commerce).

This job requires up to 25% global travel.

title: Engenheiro (A) Mlops E Llmops
description:
Com 70 anos de existência, o Einstein Hospital Israelita ainda mantém uma premissa: inovar e crescer, sempre com excelência. Ajudamos a salvar vidas, difundir o conhecimento em educação, prevenção e inovação em saúde. Além da atuação em setores assistenciais, temos oportunidades na área de Inovação, Tecnologia, Pesquisa, Ensino, entre outras. Seguimos oferecendo qualidade, afirmando nosso compromisso com a Responsabilidade Social e com o propósito de levar uma gota de Einstein para cada cidadão. Valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão de todos os talentos e buscamos profissionais que compartilhem deste mesmo propósito!


O que esperamos de você:

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar como MLOps/LLMOps para atuar na interseção entre engenharia de dados, machine learning tradicional e IA generativa. A pessoa será responsável por projetar, implementar e operar pipelines de ML end-to-end, garantindo que modelos e agentes de IA sejam implantados e monitorados em produção com alta confiabilidade, segurança e escalabilidade.

O papel envolve atuar tanto em MLOps, gerenciando o ciclo de vida de modelos treinados com dados proprietários, quanto em LLMOps, lidando com desafios específicos de LLMs, como versionamento de prompts, variabilidade de outputs, otimização de custos de inferência e monitoramento de alucinaçõe


Informações da vaga:

  • Local de trabalho: Unid Centro de Ens e Pesquisa (AECE)
  • Área: Planejamento Analytics
  • Diretoria : Digital
  • Modelo de trabalho : Híbrido
  • Jornada de trabalho : 220h/mês


Responsabilidades:

MLOps (IA Tradicional)

  • Projetar e manter pipelines CI/CD para treinamento, validacao e deploy de modelos de ML (MLflow,
  • Kubeflow, Vertex AI Pipelines)
  • Implementar IaC para ambientes de ML em cloud (GCP primario), incluindo GPU provisioning e
  • autoscaling
  • Construir e gerenciar feature stores, model registries e pipelines de dados para treinamento
  • Monitoramento de modelos em producao: data drift, concept drift, performance degradation (Evidently,
  • Whylogs, Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Garantir reproducibilidade de experimentos com versionamento de dados (DVC, lakeFS) e modelos

LLMOps (IA Generativa & Agentic AI)

  • Operar e otimizar serving de LLMs (vLLM, TGI, Triton) com foco em latencia, throughput e custo
  • Desenvolver pipelines de RAG end-to-end: ingestao, chunking, embedding, vector stores (Pinecone,
  • Weaviate, pgvector, Qdrant)
  • Versionamento de prompts, avaliacao sistematica de saidas (evals) e A/B testing de configuracoes de LLM
  • Gerenciar custo de inferencia: caching inteligente, routing entre modelos, otimizacao de tokens e batching
  • Construir infraestrutura para agentes autonomos (AgentOps): orquestracao, observabilidade, guardrails e
  • circuit breakers
  • Guardrails de seguranca para LLMs: content filtering, PII detection, compliance LGPD/HIPAA

Transversal

  • Governanca, seguranca (RBAC, auditoria) e compliance regulatorio em todo o ciclo de vida
  • Colaborar com cientistas de dados, engenheiros de software e times de produto
  • Documentar padroes, runbooks e boas praticas para escalar o conhecimento no time


Requisitos

Imprescindíveis:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em MLOps, ML Engineering ou Data/Platform Engineering, com foco em ambientes de produção
  • Solida experiência em implantação de modelos de ML em produção (não apenas em experimentação ou notebooks)
  • Experiência em práticas com workloads de IA generativa (LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning ou agentes)
  • Python avançado e proficiência em frameworks de ML (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost)
  • Containers e orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (GKE/EKS), Helm
  • Cloud: GCP (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Artifact Registry) ou equivalente AWS/Azure
  • IaC: Terraform, Pulumi ou CloudFormation
  • CI/CD para ML: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD
  • Plataformas de ML: MLflow, Kubeflow, Vertex AI Pipelines ou Metaflow
  • APIs de LLM e frameworks GenAI: OpenAI API, Anthropic API, LangChain, LlamaIndex
  • Git avançado, versionamento de dados (DVC, lakeFS) e versionamento de modelos
  • Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, Evidently AI ou Whylogs

Desejáveis:

  • Experiencia com fine-tuning de LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT) e alinhamento (RLHF/DPO)
  • Serving de modelos em GPU com otimizacao (quantizacao, batching dinamico, vLLM, TensorRT)
  • Pipelines de RAG em producao: embeddings, reranking, vector databases em escala
  • Evals e benchmarks sistematicos para LLMs (ragas, deepeval, promptfoo)
  • Orquestracao de agentes de IA (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen ou similares)
  • Certificacoes cloud (GCP Professional ML Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, Azure AI Engineer)



Einstein Benefícios – Compartilhando Bem-Estar

  • Cuidados com a saúde: Programa Cuidar com serviços realizados no Einstein para promover a saúde e bem-estar dos colaboradores e dependentes, Clínicas Einstein, Telemedicina, Convênio Farmácia, Convênio Médico, Assistência Odontológica e Consultório Dental in Company.
  • Bem-Estar: Wellhub (Gympass), TotalPass, Coral, Programa de Orientação Pessoal e SESC.
  • Para você e sua família: Licença paternidade estendida, Seguro de Vida, Creche ou Auxílio Creche para mães ou pais com guarda legal, Auxílio para Filhos com Deficiência e Previdência Privada com taxa zero.
  • Alimentação: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição ou Refeitório no local de trabalho.
  • Mobilidade: Vale Transporte, Fretado, Estacionamento, Aplicativo de Caronas e Circular Metrô.
  • Clube de Benefícios: Para economizar e obter vantagens nas compras de produtos e serviços de diversas categorias, como Beleza e Fitness, Comer e Beber, Compras, Cultura e Lazer, Educação Ensino Einstein, Turismo e muito mais.
  • Programa Mais Conectados: Trabalho remoto nas modalidades Teletrabalho ou Híbrido conforme atividade e área de atuação.

Para nós, a experiência na liderança de equipes comerciais e de atendimento ao cliente é muito importante. title: Technical Solution Engineer - Sao Paulo
description:
About CATL

CATL invites you to continue our legend of green energy!

CATL is a World Fortune 300 Company, a global leader who provides premier EV battery and energy storage battery for the world. CATL's EV battery consumption volume has ranked No.1 in the world for seven consecutive years and global energy storage battery shipment has also ranked No.1 for three consecutive years.


Job Description


ESS Technical Solution Engineer is the combination of application engineer and sales engineer. A technical solution engineer should support and service the customer by demonstrating the product function, technical benefits and value to help customer meet their company and business goals and help company to win projects. Combining technical knowledge with strong communication and interpersonal skills, work closely with clients, understanding their specific needs, and then leverage their in-depth understanding of the company's products or services to provide tailored solutions that meet those needs effectively. Additionally, technical solution engineers should gather feedback from clients and bridge the gap between internal development team and customer requirements, helping to refine products and services based on customer needs and experiences.


Responsibilities:


  1. Product Demonstration: Deep understanding of the products or services of products and company. Be able to explain complex technical concepts to clients in a clear and understandable manner and contribute to sales presentations, as well as demonstrating products benefits, value and completed applications
  2. Client Engagement: Interact directly with clients to understand their needs, challenges, and requirements as well as the competition information from the competitors. Engage in discussions to gather information, analyze the client's projects and requirements, and identify opportunities where company's solutions can add value to win the opportunities
  3. Solution Development: Once understand the client's needs, sales engineers work to develop solutions that align with the client's projects. This may involve collaborating with the technical team to design tailored solutions that address specific challenges. Provide clients with technical support as needed and relay information to our development teams for product development and update needs
  4. Proposal Creation: Create detailed proposals that outline the proposed solution and its benefits. These proposals need to address the technical aspects while also highlighting the business value for the client as well as prepare the documents according to customer requirements which may include specifications, user’s manual, disposal proposal, etc.,
  5. Technical Support: Provide ongoing technical support to clients, answering questions, addressing concerns, and helping with any technical issues that arise
  6. Technical Agreement Negotiations: Involve in negotiations with clients, addressing any technical concerns, clarifying expectations, and ensuring that both parties are aligned on the proposed solution to form final technical agreement
  7. Risk Assessment and Problem Solving: Identify the possible issues ahead and provide preventative solutions for the risks. Resolve the technical issues during manufacturing, delivering and commissioning until successfully hand over to customer. Cooperate with internal development and project management team if needed
  8. Market Research: Stay informed about market trends, competitor offerings, and customer feedback. Generate ideas for product and service improvement and innovation based on market trends and customer inputs


Requirements and skills:


  1. Based in (or open to relocation) Sao Paulo
  2. At least 2 years work experience in local ESS market
  3. Previous work experience as an AE or SE of ESS market is advantageous
  4. Previous experience in utility or ESS developer company is advantageous
  5. Knowledge of local ESS projects development requirements is advantageous
  6. Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills
  7. Excellent market and competitor analysis abilities
  8. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  9. Superb collaboration and communication
  10. Superb logical and strategic thinking abilities
  11. Proficient in English & Portuguese

title: Assistant/Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Assistant/Finance Manager (Coordenador Financeiro) will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Financial Controller (Global HQ).


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.G. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • 7 - 10 years of experience in finance and tax management within a manufacturing environment, including at least 3 years of experience in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.
